description: Claude RPG: Claude is the Archmage, you are the Medium. /rpg:party (camp in a repository), /rpg:quest (investigate, cast, trial, scroll, the Medium's judgement, merge), /rpg:questline (a road of quests to one goal), /rpg:sidequest (things found on the road), /rpg:journal (where are we), /rpg:evocation (roads ahead when you are out of mana).
